video_title: What Can We Learn From NBA Summer League?

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Summer League as a developmental tool for rookie transition
quotes.excerpt: This is a learning experience for all the new guys coming into the league.
quotes.quote: This is a learning experience for all the new guys coming into the league. Talk about the rookie transition program. This is one of the biggest rookie transition programs that they have. This is teaching all the rookies to now get rid of the shot clock that you had in college, get rid of that old defense that you were accustomed to in college where you could just camp out in the lane and you could just stand here and be big and take up space.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of understanding NBA rules and foul discipline
quotes.excerpt: Be aggressive, understand the whistle, understand what you can and what you can't do.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: As we got to see my boy Darryn Peterson do, just go ahead and just foul. Just get your fouls up. Just get it up.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He can't foul out. Nine fouls. Can't foul out. Take advantage, be aggressive, understand the whistle, understand what you can and what you can't do. And then also get reps used to what's going on.
